# 1 Enoch Chapter 19 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**1** And Uriel said to me: "Here shall stand the angels who have consorted with women. Their spirits, taking on many forms, have been defiling humanity and leading them astray so that they sacrifice to demons as to gods — and they shall remain here until the great day of judgment, at which time they shall be judged and brought to an end."

**2** "And the wives of those wayward angels shall become sirens."

**3** And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision — the ends of all things — and no man has seen what I have seen.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text, preserving sentence structure and key theological vocabulary while producing readable English prose. Chapter 19 comprises three verses in the standard Ethiopic recension. The term "sirens" is retained as a loanword from the Greek tradition underlying the Ge'ez.*
